title: potentilla obscura subsp. laciniosa
intro: Potentilla obscura subsp. laciniosa, commonly known as Silver Buffalo Berry, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla obscura subsp. laciniosa include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-microbial activity, and act as a natural anti-coagulant. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
